items.title: ZetaChain votes to shut down Layer 1 network and move ZETA to Solana
items.summary: The team plans to focus instead on Anuma, its private AI app, though the migration will still take one more vote.

items.title: Solana's Heartbeat Quickens: Block Times Fall 17% in Latest Speed Upgrade
items.summary: The network's clock just sped up again, but the extra speed goes to freshness, not capacity.

items.title: Solana Changelog: September 18, 2026
items.summary: Transaction V1 reaches mainnet as Solana targets 250ms slots, lower rent, and program deployments with four times lower fees.

items.title: How AI Is Reshaping Crypto Security, with Michael Coates
items.summary: A ~$116 million Coldcard exploit shows why crypto security must eliminate single points of failure and automate defenses for AI-speed threats.

items.title: Bitcoin reclaims $80,000, Solana and Hyperliquid rally as crypto markets shrug off Clarity setback
items.summary: The moves comes as the SEC and CFTC advance crypto-related rulemaking despite the Clarity Act stalling in the Senate.

items.title: Project Harmonia Brings Institutional Tokenized Funds to Solana
items.summary: Project Harmonia connects Allfunds, with about €1.9 trillion under administration, to tokenized funds on Solana; submissions close October 24, 2026.

items.title: Solana: Building, Proving and Earning Trust in Public
items.summary: Solana has maintained 100% uptime since February 2024, including when a routing failure took nearly 29% of network stake offline.

items.title: Solana Changelog: September 10, 2026
items.summary: V1 transaction activation is delayed to Epoch 1035, alongside new Agave, Firedancer, Web3.js, Solana Kit, and program releases.

items.title: Solana Changelog: September 3, 2026
items.summary: Firedancer adopts three RPC calls and advances ARM support, while three mainnet feature gates and new Agave, Web3.js, and Solana Kit versions land.

items.title: Report: Stablecoins Are Reshaping Remittances
items.summary: New report on stablecoin remittances covering four implementation paths for money transfer operators, corridor overviews, and case studies.

items.title: How BitRobot Crowdsources Real-World Data for Embodied AI, with Jonathan Victor
items.summary: BitRobot open-sourced 2,000 hours of robot navigation data and uses Solana to track and reward embodied AI data contributors.

items.title: Solana Transaction Versioning: Legacy, v0 and v1
items.summary: How Solana's three transaction formats differ on the wire: legacy, v0 with Address Lookup Tables, and v1's 4,096-byte redesign with native resource configuration.

items.title: Solana Ecosystem Roundup: August 2026
items.summary: Solana’s August 2026 roundup: record transactions, $4B in RWAs, growing stablecoin payments, tokenized stocks, DeFi innovation, ETFs, and governance.

items.title: Introducing the Parsed Events API and Parsed Streams
items.summary: Get fully parsed transactions for over 3,600 Solana programs with the Parsed Events API and Parsed Streams.
